chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Or the equivalent of it in fasting.' He said: 'He should evaluate the price of the sacrifice as food, then he would fast for each Mudd one day. So when the equivalents exceed two months, there is nothing more upon him than that.'
ai.seo_question: What is the method for calculating fasting days as expiation for killing game in Ihram?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the mechanism of *Damm* (expiation) by converting the monetary value of the game into a specific quantity of food (*Mudd*), linking the physical act of feeding to the spiritual discipline of fasting. This hadith highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on precise measurement in ritual law, establishing a direct correlation between the weight of the expiation and the duration of fasting, capped at two months to prevent undue hardship. It reflects the juristic principle that expiations should be proportional to the offense while remaining manageable for the individual.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [5:95] or the equivalent of it in Fasting. Heasws said: ‘He should evaluate the price of the sacrifice as food, then he would Fast for each Mudd (approximately 750 gms), one day. So when the Mudds increase upon two months, so there is nothing more upon him than it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “This is about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘. . . or equivalent of it fasting.’ [5:95]

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The offering animal is evaluated with food stuff, then for every mud (a certain measurement) he fasts one day. If the number of mud (a certain measurement) is above the number of days in two months, more than two months fasting is not obligatory on him.’”
